description: Hand-written service-level interaction ground truth for the shopfront fixture. Topic nodes are named topic:<name>; datastore nodes by compose service name.
traps: gateway depends_on redis but never uses it — no gateway->redis edge
payments calls https://api.stripe.com — external, no internal edge
every HTTP service exposes GET /health — generic paths must not cross-match
gateway/src/lib/http.ts is a URL-hole wrapper — no edge from the wrapper file itself
shipping (Go) subscribes to order.created alongside notifications — the topic has two consumers
shipping's sql.Open driver name literal ("postgres") happens to equal the compose service name, giving a second, redundant route to the same edge
edge (nginx) proxy_passes /api/ to http://gateway:3000/api/ — a literal-host proxy_pass edge; its /health location uses `return 200` with no proxy_pass and must not produce an edge

invoices (Java/Spring) resolves its RestTemplate call to payments via a @Value("${PAYMENTS_URL}")-annotated field (Spring relaxed binding to the PAYMENTS_URL env var, wired in compose) concatenated with a literal path — not a class constant or compose-URL literal like the other services

invoices's JdbcTemplate calls (queryForMap/update) are plain SQL-string calls, not annotated @Query methods — exercising the callee-hint path (queryForMap/update) rather than the @Query annotation path
invoices's spring.datasource.url in application.properties is a literal jdbc:postgresql:// URL with no env placeholder — exercising the manifest-config literal path rather than env-wire/fallback
